features: Supports 8-sensor stitching, enabling full 360° panoramic viewing
Features a 1/1.8" high-sensitivity CMOS sensor, meeting ultra-low-light (starlight-level) surveillance requirements with high clarity in night-time imaging
Supports flexible multi-lens stitching for 180°, 270°, or 360° panoramic coverage
Supports up to 8192 × 1800 @ 30fps high-resolution panoramic output, with detail channel resolution up to 2688 × 1520 @ 60fps
Supports single-IP dual-stream output, enabling simultaneous preview of panoramic and detailed live views
Panoramic vertical field of view reaches 110°, ensuring no blind spots even at a 6-meter mounting height

frigate.notes: Uniview IPC — ONVIF + Uniview /unicast RTSP path. Use the sub stream (s1) for Frigate detection.

home_assistant.notes: Use ONVIF integration. Default ONVIF port 80.
